summary.text: Kirk Talbot is a Republican member of the Louisiana State Senate representing District 10, which the legislature's member page lists as covering Jefferson Parish. First elected in 2019, Kirk Talbot chairs the Insurance Committee and sits on the Judiciary B, Labor and Industrial Relations, and Retirement committees.

paragraphs.text: According to his Senate biography, Kirk Talbot's District 10 includes Kenner, Harahan, River Ridge, and portions of Metairie.
The biography says he was elected to the Senate in 2019 after 12 years as the State Representative for House District 78.

It says he serves on the boards of several insurance-related bodies, including the Louisiana Citizens Property Insurance Corporation and the Louisiana Office of Group Benefits, and is a member of the French Quarter Business Association.
The biography says he is married to the former Julie Strong of Oak Grove, Louisiana, and that they have two children.
The Senate page gives Kirk Talbot's education as a B.A. in business administration from the University of Mississippi.

The Senate page lists Kirk Talbot's committee assignments as Insurance (chair), Judiciary B, Labor and Industrial Relations, Retirement, Commerce, Consumer Protection and International Affairs (ex officio), and Senate Executive Committee, and caucus and delegation affiliations as Jefferson Parish Legislative Delegation and Louisiana Republican Legislative Delegation.
